extracted.name: Easy Cold Cucumber Soup
extracted.description: This easy cucumber soup recipe blends fresh mint, dill, and garlic with thick yogurt and sour cream for a refreshing, light, delicious summer lunch.
ingredient_lines: 2 large cucumbers - peeled, seeded, and diced
instruction_lines: Combine cucumbers, broth, sour cream, yogurt, and garlic in a large bowl; blend with an immersion blender until smooth.
Add mint and dill; blend to combine. Refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour.
